transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because... for months now, I've been seeing the exact same pattern in my project files at work. I'm a translator, and certain subcontractors, along with one colleague in particular, keep making these tiny changes to the translation memory and the file timestamps. 

They're doing it so it looks like my quality control failed. I've brought it up, and even when IT says the audit trail is completely clean, I know what I'm looking at. The record has been deliberately arranged to put the blame on me.
Have you ever heard voices, sounds, or whispering that other people around you couldn't hear?

No, I haven't. I don't hear voices or whispering or anything like that. My hearing is perfectly fine. 

It's... well, it's really just what I'm seeing on the computer. The issue is strictly with the files and the data, not anything I'm hearing.
Aside from this frustration at work, how has your overall mood been over these past few months?

My mood? It's... well, it's been mostly fine, honestly. I mean, obviously, I'm pretty stressed about what's going on with the files. It's incredibly frustrating to deal with that every day. But aside from the work situation... I don't feel depressed or anything like that. Outside of work, I'm just my normal self. It's really just that one specific issue that's bothering me.
Have you generally found it difficult to trust people throughout your life, even before these issues at work began?

No, not really. I've never had a problem trusting people before. I mean, sure, I've had normal disagreements or moments where I didn't see eye-to-eye with someone, but... no, generally I trust people just fine. 

That's why this whole thing at work is so baffling to me. I've worked with some of these subcontractors for a while without any issues. It's only recently, with this specific project and these specific file changes, that I've realized what they're doing. Before this, I never had any reason to suspect anyone was out to get me.
Have you had any new medical problems, head injuries, or physical health changes around the time this started?

No, I haven't. My physical health is perfectly fine. I haven't had any head injuries, illnesses, or... or anything like that. Nothing has changed medically. Like I said, it's really just the stress from dealing with what they are doing to my work. Physically, I feel completely normal.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient exhibits a well-encapsulated, non-bizarre persecutory delusion regarding coworkers and subcontractors tampering with work files and audit trails to sabotage quality control, persisting for several months. There is an absence of auditory or other hallucinations, no primary mood disorder, no pre-existing paranoid personality disorder, and no underlying general medical or neurological etiology, fulfilling ICD-10 criteria for Persistent Delusional Disorder (F22).
